Updated Nov 14, 2021: Contacted Waterdrop with my complaint about the alignment of the lugs to the handle on the bottom of the filter. They asked for some photos and my order number, which I sent to them, and they issued me a full refund. I give Waterdrop high marks for their customer service and willing to issue a refund, I didn't even ask for a refund. I hope their manufacturing in the future gets the lugs aligned properly, because we have no complaints at all about the filtering properties of the filters - they seem to work great.

Bought a 2 pack of these a year ago and they were perfect OEM copies. Bought this 3-pack and was very frustrated by them. The lugs which lock the filter into the filter-housing in the fridge are not indexed correctly to the handle on the bottom of the filter. This means the filter handle doesn't sit at a 90-degree angle, and this means the black plastic trim piece on the fridge doesn't go on either. They also changed the design of the lugs from the 2-pack I bought last year - the old lugs did seem to snap into the filter housing a lot more solidly, the new ones are a more simple molding but do not lock into the filter housing as securely.

Once I got the filter installed, there were no leaks, and the water tastes fine - but it's frustrating to buy a product, be happy with it, and 1 year later buy the same brand and part number and find the manufacturer changed the design... for the worse in this case.

My only beef with this machine is the sound it makes when the drum is spinning. I may have gotten an unbalanced drum, because it clearly hits something inside after a full rotation...but it surely does compensate for the noise with the time it takes to dry a load of laundry. My washing machine is also small, so the full load fits into the dryer perfectly, with room to spare. I set it to the highest temp (180 minutes), and after 25-30 minutes items are completely dry and the machine is ready for a new load. I figured you spend less electricity by running on high for 30 minutes than running the cycle on low or medium for over an hours and clothes are still damp. Bought the kit to vent machine inside the house, and it actually blows hot air inside the house without any lint, after running all the remaining lint thru the water. You do not need to clean inside the drum lint filter after every cycle, but once a day for sure, since it gets pretty clogged. Good luck!!!

Pleasantly surprised. I got this as a for our downstairs master restroom and paired it with the magic chef 1.6 cu ft washer.  I have a hard time carry laundry up & down the stairs and was looking for something compact that could handle everyday items. This mighty dryer was able to handle a medium thick queen size comforter & Standard pillows, although not at the same time, but I tell you I might not bother going upstairs again.
This dryer works very well and it small enough to fit anywhere.

We've only had ours for a couple days, but it works very well! It fits a good amount of clothes. Our portable washer fits 1.1 cu ft, and I was able to dry 2 washer loads at the same time with room to spare. We also have a spin dryer, so we can cut the dry time to about that of a normal dryer by running the clothes through there first. You'll need a vent kit, which you can get pretty cheaply. We have ours venting out a window. I would not recommend venting any dryer indoors for safety reasons, and it would also make the room pretty hot.

The top and sides were slightly warped in transit, but it's not very noticeable and hasn't caused a problem. My only other complaint so far is that while this unit is meant to sit on the floor, the controls are on the bottom. I can't give it 5 stars because I can't see the lower half of the dial when I'm setting the timer, unless I get down on my hands and knees. Many others on the market are the same way, though. The price seems to be climbing since we got ours, and I wouldn't pay the price posted as of 8/12/20. While I do love it, I can't see how it differs form other brands, but I haven't tried any others. Overall, we're very happy with it, and glad to have something that fits in our space.
